note: Grand Valley RD (GMUG) campground at ~10,300 ft on a spruce-covered mountainside above Eggleston Lake, a few sites overlooking the lake; 12.5 miles up gravel FR 121 from the end of the pavement south of Collbran. Plentiful mosquitoes. The Crag Crest Trail is nearby. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov Scan & Pay listing: confirmed 11 sites (5-6 tent-only, no turnaround), 27-ft max spur, vault toilet, no water, FCFS, $14 (extra vehicle $7). Season now the FS dates June 12 - Sept 15. 'Site Closed' = end of season. Lakeview confirmed by the FS page ('A few sites overlook the lake'). Pin = FS point on FR 121 at the lakeshore turn-in, below the hillside loop. Note trimmed; the unsourced 'rutted/steep spur ... higher-clearance rigs' line dropped (see flags).
flags: Rig length: the FS page's 'Maximum spur length - 27 ft' is the agency's stated figure (23 ft+), and the page does not single the campground out for small rigs - 'no turn around' refers only to tent sites 5 and 6. No CRITERIA problem, but with an 11-site loop on a steep spruce slope a 23-ft rig will have little room to spare.

Dropped from the old note, no agency source: 'Gravel access (FR-121) then a rutted/steep spur to the pay station - best for shorter, higher-clearance rigs.' The FS page gives only the directions (FR 121 gravel, 'Turn right into campground'). Worth a 2WD/clearance check before a visit; no 4WD or high-clearance advice found on the agency pages.
Missing phone: Grand Valley Ranger District, (970) 242-8211 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/offices).
Pin is the FS point, on FR 121 at the lake's north shore where the campground road turns off uphill; the loop itself is just north under spruce (not resolvable on imagery). Probably within ~150 m.
